steps: Shut off power at the outdoor disconnect and breaker.
Remove leaves, grass clippings, and debris from around and inside the fins.
Gently rinse the fins from the inside out with a garden hose (low pressure).
Straighten bent fins carefully with a fin comb.
Trim back plants/shrubs to keep 2 ft of clearance on all sides.
